[host_machine]
system = 'darwin'
cpu_family = 'x86_64'
cpu = 'x86_64'
endian = 'little'

[binaries]
c = 'clang'
objc = 'clang'
cpp = 'clang++'
ar = 'ar'
ld = 'ld'
strip = 'strip'
lipo = 'lipo'
ranlib = 'ranlib'
# Gives NASM-assembled objects a macOS build version, as clang does for C;
# without it, ld warns that they have no platform load command.
nasm = ['nasm', '--pragma', 'macho build_version macos, 12, 0']

[built-in options]
prefix = '/usr/local'
c_args = ['-arch', 'x86_64', '-mmacosx-version-min=12.0']
c_link_args = ['-arch', 'x86_64', '-mmacosx-version-min=12.0']
default_library = 'static'
buildtype = 'release'
